Interactive Parent Guide

When Should You Consult Dr. Vivek Gupta?

A quick guide for parents to identify healthy milestones and know when timely medical attention is needed.

🎯 Healthy Milestones to Watch

  • Turns head toward parent's voice and sounds
  • Follows moving objects with both eyes (by 2–3 months)
  • Steady head control during tummy time (by 3–4 months)
  • Social smile and responsive cooing (by 2 months)

🩺 When to Book a Clinic Visit

  • Baby is not gaining weight or feeding poorly
  • Yellowish tint on skin or eyes persisting past 2 weeks
  • Vaccines due at 6, 10, and 14 weeks

💡 Doctor's Advice: Exclusive breastfeeding is recommended up to 6 months of age. Consult Dr. Gupta for personalized latch and growth reviews.

🎯 Healthy Milestones to Watch

  • Sits steadily without support (around 6–8 months)
  • Babbling with consonant sounds (e.g. "ba-ba", "da-da")
  • Pincer grasp: picks up small objects between thumb and finger

🩺 When to Book a Clinic Visit

  • Starting solid foods (weaning plan consultation)
  • Vaccines due at 6 months and 9 months (MMR, Typhoid)
  • Child does not bear weight on legs when supported

💡 Doctor's Advice: Never force-feed solids. Introduce single ingredients one at a time to monitor for food sensitivities.

🎯 Healthy Milestones to Watch

  • Independent walking and climbing low steps
  • Vocabulary of 20+ words by 18 months, 2-word phrases by 2 years
  • Shows pretend play (feeding a toy, imitating parents)

🩺 When to Book a Clinic Visit

  • No words by 18 months or no eye contact when addressed
  • Extremely picky eating or declining growth curve
  • Booster vaccines due at 15–18 months and 2 years

💡 Doctor's Advice: Early intervention is the key to speech and motor delays. Never wait if your parental instinct feels something is off.

🚨 Symptoms That Require Immediate Care

  • Fever in an infant younger than 3 months (>100.4°F)
  • Difficulty breathing, grunting, or rapid chest retractions
  • Signs of severe dehydration: no wet diaper in 8+ hours, sunken eyes
  • Extreme lethargy, difficulty waking up, or persistent vomiting

Dr. Vivek Gupta's clinic provides direct guidance for concerning childhood symptoms. If your child exhibits any of the signs on the left, call our helpline immediately.
